notes: Antarctica (STK's Irrlicht fork). Runs in its Direct3D 9 mode (--render-driver=directx9; OpenGL is STK's own default) through wined3d's Vulkan renderer (MoltenVK in the plain Wine tree), because the runner has no hardware OpenGL. Checked 2026-11-14: main menu on windows-latest (WARP) and on the Mac runner, same picture; both fall back to the fixed pipeline because d3dx9_43.dll is missing ('Could not load shader function D3DXAssembleShader'). config.xml: enable_internet=2 skips the internet question, <Video old_driver_popup="false"/> (group settings are attributes) hides the 'graphics driver appears to be very old' popup the fixed pipeline triggers. players.xml with a current player skips the first-run player screen. DXVK-macOS d3d9 can't make a device on the runner (MoltenVK: geometryShader and shaderCullDistance not available). The OpenGL mode reaches the menu only with Mesa llvmpipe's opengl32.dll next to the exe.
